contract: One shared, dependency-light module defines the supported CIDS Essential profile as version 3.2.0. The exporter uses those constants, and the registered task validator rejects any other version or alignment tier even when the document and output envelope agree.
limitations: Pinning version and Essential tier does not validate every JSON-LD term against the external CIDS specification or live reference context.
Populated parity, full source snapshots, production grants, and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
